| Deploy on table. [[A Jedi's Resilience]] may not be played during move phases. [[The Circle Is Now Complete]] or [[Vader's Obsession]] may be played during any move phase to initiate an epic duel as follows: If Vader present with specified target, each player draws two destiny (if armed with a lightsaber, each destiny is +1); add ability. == Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on every Virtual Legacy [[Epic Duel (V)]] article. Use '''Edit errata''' on a member page. One column per published text state; {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed; an em dash if that field is unchanged from the previous column. Same-words image changes are not columns: [[Epic Duel (V) (Errata 3)]] shares the [[Epic Duel (V) (Errata 2)]] column. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
